name: store-locator
description: A front-end store locator module built on MapLibre GL JS
author: tete-chercheuse

scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo:serve
scripts.build:core: microbundle build --entry src/store-locator.ts --format modern,esm --compress false --sourcemap false --no-generateTypes
scripts.build:react: microbundle build --entry src/react.ts --output dist/react.modern.mjs --format modern --compress false --sourcemap false --no-generateTypes --pkg-main false && microbundle build --entry src/react.ts --output dist/react.esm.js --format esm --compress false --sourcemap false --no-generateTypes --pkg-main false
scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:core && npm run build:react && npm run build:types
scripts.watch: microbundle watch --entry src/store-locator.ts --format modern,esm --compress false --sourcemap false --no-generateTypes
scripts.refresh: npm run clean; npm run init
